semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Yeh Jeh Co., Ltd specializes in cooling solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing and data center operations.
summary: Yeh Jeh Co., Ltd is a Taiwan-based OEM manufacturer that provides advanced heat exchangers and liquid-cooling solutions specifically designed for AI servers, data centers, and semiconductor systems. Their product offerings include Rear Door Heat Exchangers (RDHX) and Stainless Steel Heat Exchangers, which are tailored for high-density environments requiring efficient thermal management.
capabilities: Rear Door Heat Exchangers (RDHX) for AI server cooling
Stainless Steel Heat Exchangers for semiconductor facilities
